question: That is fine. I know that many people are not paying the share to uncle Sam. Anyway, Can I file my tax return  online?

answers: Yes, you can file your tax return online. There are several online services that can help you with this, such as TurboTax, HR Block, and Tax Slayer. These services are generally free to use and you only pay when you're ready to file. They also allow you to take your time and save your progress, so you can start using it and go ask questions/do research on your own time. Additionally, if your return is relatively simple, you can use the IRS's Free File program to file your taxes for free. If you prefer to file a paper return, you can mail it to the IRS using USPS certified mail.

history.content: Hi there! I do not know how  to do my income taxes. May I ask for some tips,please

Sure, I'd be happy to help you with some general tips on doing your income taxes. 
Firstly, it's important to keep track of all your sources of income, as you are required to report "all income from any source" to the IRS. This includes income from employment, self-employment, investments, and even "found" property or money. If you are a low income taxpayer, you may be eligible to use the IRS's Free File program, which provides free filing software options. If you have had income where tax has been taken out, you may have overpaid the tax. Filing the tax return will allow you to get a refund of the amount that you overpaid. If you are a student, you may be eligible for student tax credits that can get you a refund even if you did not pay any tax during the year. It's also recommended to take a look at the "Excel 1040" tool, which is a spreadsheet version of IRS form 1040. It can help you calculate your income tax and self-employment tax, and it's more convenient for tax estimation compared to most websites and tax-prep software. If your financial affairs are more complex, you may need to pay Income Tax and National Insurance through Self Assessment and fill in a tax return every year.
You're welcome! I'm glad I could help. Do you addition questions?
Yes. My friend told me that she pays the tax in advance to Income tax. Is this possible?

Yes, it is possible to pay your income tax in advance  Estimate how much you are earned, find out the tax liability and pay the tax in advance to Income Tax.You need to add this to your overall income and pay tax. You would also need to file returns every year.
I see. How is the minimum that I need to earn to file tax return.

In the U.S., if you are single, under 65, and not a dependent on someone else's return, you are not required to file if your 2015 income was less than $10,300. However, if you will be claimed as a dependent on someone else's return, you must file if your earned income (from work) was over $6300, or your unearned income (from investments) was over $1050, or your gross (total) income was more than the larger of either $1050 or your earned income + $350. Keep in mind that these thresholds can change from year to year, so it's always a good idea to check the most recent tax guidelines.Additionally, even if you are not required to file an income-tax return, you might want to choose to file a tax return anyway. This is because if your employer withheld income tax from your salary but your tax liability for the year is zero, then, in the absence of a filed tax return, the IRS will not refund the tax withheld to you. Nor will your employer return the withheld money to you saying ""Oops, we made a mistake last year"". That money is gone: an unacknowledged (and non-tax-deductible) gift from you to the US government.
Wow, even if you make little money, you need to file income taxes. How do the illegals file their income taxes if they do not have proper documention?
